items.reason: Whole-set routing prints the set identifier, Runtime path, and binding kind before the status table.
Header emission is unconditional after successful routing, including inside the bound checkout.
The header compares checkout roots rather than invocation directories, omitting subdirectory differences and reporting the root instead of the actual cwd.
BoundDefault triggers the “binding recorded to current checkout” announcement.
The old “draining at bound checkout” output is removed.
Single-task AFK runs print the current-checkout path without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the single-task HITL branch.
Successful whole-set tasks print one green “✓ <set>/<task> done” line.
Commit SHA or verified no-op details print beneath the green result line.
The old completion printer is removed, and each task ending has one result-line emission.
Exhausted retries that fail the task produce one red failed result line.
Exhaustion that leaves the task open produces the distinct red “out of agents (left open)” line.
Quota parking prints the yellow quota-paused line with the selected preset.
Interrupted agent execution prints one yellow interrupted result line.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reporting paths without Task result lines.
Attempt failure narration, timing breakdowns, and exhausted-walk narration remain intact.
Shared output formatting preserves complete lines and suppresses ANSI for redirected output.
Task result lines use existing TTY color handling and honor NO_COLOR.
Header and result printers add no journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear, centralized presentation changes with useful regression coverage; invocation-directory handling violates one requirement, and tests miss that case.
